text: {"reply":"Hi {first_name}, thank you for writing. Your potassium result was 5.3 mmol/L. The lab's range is 3.5 to 5.1, so your result is a little above that range. Your clinician can talk with you about what this means for you, including your food choices like your daily banana. Please don't change any of your medicines or your eating on your own before you hear from them. If you notice new or worse symptoms, you can book a visit or call the clinic."}
